Package dev.turboism.sdk.plugin

Interface PluginDescriptor

public interface PluginDescriptor
Public contract of a plugin descriptor read from META-INF/turboism/plugin.json.

    • category

      default Optional<String> category()
      Declared primary classification category, or empty for descriptors without one (schema v2 and legacy descriptors).

      Descriptive metadata only: it grants no permission, capability, or execution-policy effect. Values are canonical lowercase kebab-case IDs; display localization is owned by consumers.

      Returns:
      the declared category token when the descriptor provides one

    • tags

      default List<String> tags()
      Declared canonical classification tags in declaration order.

      Descriptive metadata only: it grants no permission, capability, or execution-policy effect. The returned list is immutable; descriptors without tags (schema v2 and legacy descriptors) expose an empty list.

      Returns:
      immutable declared tags, never null

    • eventExports

      default List<PluginDescriptor.EventExport> eventExports()
      Public event contracts this plugin provides to declared dependents.

      The provider plugin id is implicit in this descriptor. Event ids are stable within that provider and contract versions govern payload ABI.

      Returns:
      immutable exports in declaration order

    • eventImports

      default List<PluginDescriptor.EventImport> eventImports()
      Public event contracts this plugin consumes from declared dependencies.
      Returns:
      immutable imports in declaration order

    • eventContracts

      default List<PluginDescriptor.EventContract> eventContracts()
      Independently published public event contract artifacts embedded in this plugin archive. Each entry names a class-only JAR stored under META-INF/turboism/contracts/ together with its identity, version and the SHA-256 of the artifact bytes. Provider and consumer plugins embed the exact same published artifact bytes so the runtime can bind one shared class identity for the contract across all of them.
      Returns:
      immutable contract artifact declarations in declaration order
